content.value: A turbojet engine flying at a speed of 720 km/hr, consumes air at the rate 42 kg/sec. Given the enthalpy change for the nozzle is 175 kJ/kg, velocity coefficient is 0.95, air-fuel ratio is 71, heating value of the fuel is 42 MJ/kg, and combustion efficiency is 95%; Calculate: (i) thrust specific fuel consumption; (ii) thermal efficiency of the plant; (iii) propulsive power; and (iv) overall efficiency.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2020
